annual_yield.source: solar.org.uk UK solar generation by location dataset, modelled from PVGIS 5.3 (European Commission JRC), CC BY 4.0

system_capacity.source: UK Government Warm Homes Plan Technical Annex; modelled domestic PV installation described as a common installation size

self_consumption_ratio.source: UK Government Cost-Optimal Domestic Electrification study (CODE), mid-terrace cavity-wall archetype, annual PV-only self-consumption

limitations: A London reference-location yield is used only for synthetic records labelled London; it is not a site-specific address or a yield for any other region.
Capacity and self-consumption are representative scenario assumptions, not customer observations; real values depend on roof area, pitch, orientation, shading, load profile and storage.
PVGIS-derived yield data source uses 20% system losses and a 35-degree south-facing setup; this does not describe every property.
Annual grid displacement is capped by estimated annual demand; exports receive no carbon credit.
